title: Route render diverged from training: 0/50 token parity
detail: At b438799 options() hard-coded short special-option descriptions (MULTI_STEP 'needs several actions, apps or UI steps', etc.) instead of catalog special_options, and ctx last_action=None rendered 'None' (training uses `or "none"`). Every route prompt differed from the Tinker training render, silently destroying LoRA accuracy.
evidence: Tokenized all 50 rows of training/artifacts/route_render_samples.jsonl@5da307e with the runtime renderer: 0/50 identical; first diff at token 674 (' needs several actions...' vs ' The request needs several UI steps or apps; hand off to the planner.'). With catalog descriptions + last_action None->'none': 47/50 (rest = live online probe vs ctx online=false).
fix: Build options from catalog.special_options; render ctx.get(k) or 'none'; let ctx online override probe; add a parity test against the artifact.

title: Args prompt signature format differs from training arg_signature
detail: Runtime arg_signature dropped enum values and ' optional' (e.g. 'kind:str' vs training 'kind:enum any|pdf|image|video|document|folder optional'), so the args extractor saw a prompt it was never trained on.

title: parse_duration returns wrong seconds for compound spoken numbers
detail: The regex alternation matches only the last number word before the unit, so 'twenty five minutes' -> 300 (5 min) and 'forty-five minutes' -> 300; '1 hour and a half' -> 3600. A timer silently set to the wrong length is worse than ASK. Words like thirteen/fifty/seventy are missing (-> None).
evidence: bcd3b75: parse_duration('twenty five minutes')=300, ('forty-five minutes')=300, ('1 hour and a half')=3600, ('one and a half hours')=None, ('thirteen minutes')=None. tests: test_brain3_duration_compound_numbers (3 fail).
fix: Tokenize a number phrase first (tens + units with optional hyphen, 'and a half', 11-19, 50/70/80), then multiply by unit; if any number word adjacent to the matched one is unconsumed return None (ASK).

title: parse_datetime silently returns wrong dates and times
detail: dateparser with PREFER_DATES_FROM=future reads bare numbers as months and drops times it cannot attach: reminders/events get created months off or at the current clock time with no ASK.
evidence: bcd3b75 at 2026-10-24T05:23Z: 'tomorrow at 9' -> 2026-10-25T05:23:33 (hour = now, not 9); 'at 3' -> 2027-03-24T00:00; 'friday at 3' -> 2027-03-24T00:00; 'the 5th at 10am' -> 2027-05-24T10:00; 'next friday at 3pm'/'tonight' -> None. tests: test_brain3_datetime_never_silently_wrong (3 fail).
fix: Pre-parse spoken patterns (weekday/today/tomorrow/tonight/morning + 'at H[:MM] [am|pm]', 'in N units') with a small rule parser; pass RELATIVE_BASE and PREFER_DAY_OF_MONTH; reject results >60 days out or whose hour differs from an explicit 'at H' -> ASK.

title: 37th route option crashes: renderer ignores filtered usable_ids
detail: AlphaChoiceRenderer computes usable_ids (58) but render_choices (vendor PrefixedChoiceRenderer) zips labels with self.IDS = A-Z0-9a-z unfiltered. Catalog has exactly 32 skills + 4 specials = 36; adding one skill (or the planned shortlist >36) assigns id 'a', which merges into the prefix and raises ConfigurationError on every route call.
evidence: vendor/tinker_decisions.py:253-262 zips self.IDS; real Qwen3.5 tokenizer: 37 options -> ConfigurationError "'a' -> ['<merged into prefix>']". test_brain4_37th_option_gets_id_b_not_crash fails.
fix: In AlphaChoiceRenderer.__init__: `self.IDS = keep` after filtering (ids then match training's 58-id alphabet: ...9 b d e f h ...).

title: MLX forward passes run on the event loop, blocking receive loop
detail: engine.route()/engine.args() are synchronous MLX calls invoked directly inside the async utterance task. While they run, the server cannot read rpc_result, cancel, partial or new final utterances, nor send ui 'thinking'. A new utterance/cancel arriving mid-forward cannot preempt it, and a cold first route (cache build ~700-token prefill) stalls the socket for its full duration.
evidence: test_brain5_engine_does_not_block_event_loop: engine.route sleeping 0.5 s (stand-in for a forward pass) -> concurrent 20 ms ticker lagged 0.511 s.
fix: Run engine calls in a single-thread executor: `res = await loop.run_in_executor(self._mlx_pool, self.engine.route, text, ctx)` (one worker so MLX state stays serialized); check task cancellation after each await.

title: Route context is constant: app/focused/selection/last_action never populated
detail: Orchestrator._ctx is fixed at app=none focused=none selection=False last_action=none and never updated; server.py:101-105 drops the utterance `ctx` that AGENTS.md@bcd3b75 now specifies, and nothing sets last_action after a skill runs. Training contexts carry real apps/last actions (context-dependent requests like 'make it louder', 'close it'), so routing loses that signal and these requests are a train/serve skew.
evidence: grep: only reads of self._ctx (orchestrator.py:139,165,182); server _start_utterance(msg.get('text','')) only; BrainConnection.swift sends no ctx; training samples contain e.g. app=Safari/last_action values.
fix: Pass msg.get('ctx') through _start_utterance -> on_utterance -> handle_utterance(text, ctx); after a successful skill set self._ctx['last_action'] = f"{skill} " + ' '.join(f'{k}="{v}"' for raw args); Swift: attach ctx at key-down.

title: last_action quoting differs from training LAST_ACTIONS format
detail: Runtime quotes an arg only if it is a str containing a space, so 'play_music query=lofi' / 'web_search query=weather'; training renders 'play_music query="lofi"', 'web_search query="weather"' (and unquoted app=/path=/action=). Every follow-up after a one-word query renders a last_action string the router never saw; small but systematic train/serve skew on exactly the context-dependent requests last_action exists for.
evidence: training/src/muselet_train/contexts.py:28-33@4cbb74a vs orchestrator.py@1d7cc07: f'{k}="{v}"' if isinstance(v,str) and ' ' in v else f'{k}={v}'.
fix: Move one format_last_action(skill, raw_args, catalog) into catalog code shared with training: quote values of free-text args (type string/duration/datetime, e.g. query, duration, text) always; leave app/path/enum/int/bool bare.
